analysis.original_request: Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (constant refractive index 1.52, lossless), with air incidence (index 1.0). Use only lossless constant-index SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40), one layer of each in either order. Each layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm. At normal incidence with s polarization, minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance sampled from 450 to 700 nm at 5 nm spacing. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated target. Use deterministic TMM only, with no RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogate or hardware. Allow at most two executed research rounds with one route and at most 64 solver evaluations per round, seed 17. After observing the actual result, choose a justified adjustment or stop. Do not claim the target was met without the spectrum and independent numeric check.
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (refractive index 1.52, lossless) with air incidence (index 1.0). The design must use exactly one layer of lossless SiO2 (n=1.46) and one layer of lossless TiO2 (n=2.40) in either stacking order. Each layer thickness is constrained between 40 nm and 160 nm. The objective is to minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at normal incidence, sampled from 450 nm to 700 nm in 5 nm steps. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated performance target. The method must use deterministic Transfer Matrix Method (TMM) only, excluding RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogates, or hardware acceleration. The process allows at most two research rounds with one route and up to 64 solver evaluations per round using seed 17. Decisions to adjust or stop must be based on observed results and independent numeric checks.
analysis.compatibility_reason: The request specifies a planar, laterally uniform, linear, isotropic layered stack under frequency-domain plane-wave illumination, which fits the solver boundary. All materials are lossless and constant-index, and the calculation method (TMM) is supported.
preferred_behaviors: minimized arithmetic mean power reflectance in the 450-700 nm band
mean reflectance below 0.03 as a soft scoring preference
suppressed_behaviors: high reflection in the 450-700 nm band
design_variables: stacking order of SiO2 and TiO2 layers
thickness of the SiO2 layer (bounded 40-160 nm)
thickness of the TiO2 layer (bounded 40-160 nm)
manufacturing_constraints: layer thickness must be between 40 nm and 160 nm
exactly one layer of SiO2 and one layer of TiO2
assumptions: refractive indices are constant over the specified wavelength range
interfaces are perfectly sharp and planar
method_research_questions: which stacking order and thickness combination yields the lowest mean reflectance within the evaluation budget
whether the 0.03 target is achievable given the material constraints and thickness bounds
